main.description: Add a software.release.status record about one of the caller's projects or versions. Statuses are never edited or deleted: to cancel one, add another with status `withdrawn` that names it in `withdraws`.

subject.description: The caller's software.release.project or software.release.version the status is about.

status.description: An ECMA-428 event type. `endOfDevelopment`, `endOfSupport` and `supersededBy` deprecate the subject; `endOfDistribution` makes it unavailable; `endOfLife` retires it; `withdrawn` cancels the status named in `withdraws`.

kind.description: Why, as a category a client can act on.

reason.description: Why, in words shown to operators.

supersededBy.description: Required when status is `supersededBy`: the version of the same project to use instead.

withdraws.description: Required when status is `withdrawn`: the caller's software.release.status record to cancel.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The caller's identity could not be determined, so there is no repo to write to.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The registry has no identity configured. An operator problem, not a caller's.

errors.name: InvalidRecord
errors.description: The input breaks a rule the registry applies, so it would refuse the records. The message names the field.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: A record could not be written to the caller's repo. Records written before the failure stay, and the same call can be made again.

errors.name: SubjectNotFound
errors.description: The subject, or the status named in withdraws, is not an indexed record of the caller's.

errors.name: InvalidStatus
errors.description: The status is missing a field it requires, such as supersededBy or withdraws, or names one that is not valid.
